How these counts work

This page counts only codes that were verified on a firm's own website in the Nov 26, 2026 research: 35 codes across 24 firms. Where a firm stated an end date, it is shown on the card as an Ends badge. Several of these are Black Friday and Black Week offers, so after the end date treat the code as expired unless the firm's checkout still accepts it.
